name: tracing
description: Trace OpenAI Codex Antennae sessions to Langfuse without per-user API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Trace Antennae Codex sessions to Langfuse
interface.longDescription: Uploads completed OpenAI Codex rollout transcripts to Langfuse after the session calls Antennae MCP, so teams can inspect those sessions as traces: agent turns, model calls, tool executions, token usage, and subagent threads. Derived from the Langfuse Codex observability plugin (MIT).
